name: cut green oak stick
description: a small, cut, green stick with reddish-brown bark
details: A small, slender oak stick, cut cleanly at both ends so that the white, five-pointed pith shows at its centre.  Its reddish-brown bark is hairless and dotted with pale lenticels, and a few small, blunt, reddish-brown buds cluster near its tip.  The wood is still green and bends rather than breaking.
keywords: cut green oak stick small stick cut stick green stick reddish-brown bark pale lenticels blunt reddish-brown buds green wood white five-pointed pith
